faq.a: Airdrop 3 will distribute 90,000,000 SHFL over 52 weeks starting on 07 March 2026. It is designed to reward long-term eligible players and ongoing weekly engagement, with tokens unlocking progressively through gameplay activity under a structured wager-to-vest model.

Stage 1 is limited to the top 50,000 eligible players based on a snapshot ranking from 1 December 2024 to 1 March 2026. Stage 2 rewards the top 10,000 eligible players each week through the Weekly SHFL Airdrop. For more information, you can check out this article here. Eligibility criteria applies.
Permanently excluded, closed, or restricted accounts are not eligible for the Weekly SHFL Airdrop.

faq.q: What is the Weekly SHFL Airdrop?
faq.a: Following the initial airdrop week, Airdrop 3 continues as the Weekly SHFL Airdrop, a recurring weekly event from Saturday 12:00 AM UTC to Friday 11:59 PM UTC, where eligible players can earn points and compete for a place among the top 10,000. Learn more in this article here. Eligibility criteria applies.

All SHFL tokens start with 10% unlocked immediately, and the rest unlock as you wager. Normally, 1 SHFL unlocks for every $20 USD wagered, but successfully completing Level 2 verification (or Level 3 verification, at our request) halves this to $10 USD per SHFL.

faq.q: Does verification increase my Airdrop rewards?
faq.a: No, there are no bonuses or extra SHFL for successful Level 2 or Level 3 verification completion. However, successfully completing Level 2 verification (or Level 3 verification, at our request) lets you unlock your Weekly Airdrop rewards at a rate of $10 USD wagered per SHFL instead of $20 USD.
Airdrop 3 prizes accumulate in your dashboard during the campaign. Be sure to claim your SHFL tokens while Weekly Airdrops are active.

faq.q: How do I claim my Airdrop?
faq.a: Unlocked tokens accumulate in your account until claimed. If you are eligible, you can claim them directly from your token dashboard or by scrolling to the top of this page. For detailed steps, you can check out this article here. Eligibility criteria applies.

faq.q: How are the weekly points calculated?
faq.a: Weekly points are calculated using a weighted formula that considers total wagered amount, house edge, game type, currency used, and VIP rank. Originals and SHFL wagering receive boosts! To understand how it is calculated, you can check out this article here. Eligibility criteria applies.

Emissions begin at a higher level and decrease over the first 20 weeks before stabilising at up to 1,000,000 SHFL per week. This structure is designed to support gradual and sustainable distribution.

faq.q: Are all wagers eligible for Weekly SHFL Airdrop points?
faq.a: Points are awarded for Casino wagers, Sports wagers, and Lottery Standard or PowerPlay purchases only.

faq.q: How are Sports wagers counted for Weekly SHFL Airdrop points?
faq.a: Sports wagers are counted using the same weighted formula as Casino games, taking into account wager amount, bet type, currency, and VIP rank. Multi-leg bets generally earn more points than single bets for the same wager. For full details and examples, you can check out this article here. Eligibility criteria applies.
